text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Man, I really didn't expect a sakura cake 
to show up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Back in the day, we used to buy them for 
everyone's birthday and eat them all the 
time, didn't we~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You always loved that cake, Chiyo-chan. 
You'd get so restless whenever someone's 
birthday was coming up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
C-Come on, stop that~. I was still little 
back then...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Still, didn't the shop that made those 
sakura cakes relocate quite a while 
ago...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It wasn't too far of a distance to 
travel.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I remembered the name of the shop, so 
I found it right away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Really!? You went all the way out just to 
buy it for me!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The manager remembered us and Chiyono 
O-san, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
She also said she was going to send a 
message card to Chiyono O-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I see... Ahh, I really am one 
lucky girl!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right! For the sake of the two of you, 
everyone in the club... and all our 
supporters! I've gotta get even stronger!
